rateform

components · 0.3.0 · v4 C2 · aj-c-rateform

The thumbs-down form (Ask's answers and the journal's notes): one row as tall as the thumb's box, the field with Send at its end inside one --rule border; "What was wrong?" is its placeholder and its name. It sits in the row that holds the thumbs, after the thumbs down (the thumbs place it); sending it fills the thumb red.

Open

As it opens after the thumbs down: one row as tall as the thumb's box, the question as the placeholder, Send at its end.

Empty

The box's border thickens inward as every field's does (the thumbs focus it on opening).
